issues_in: Source reachability: two wdm.iowa.gov URLs (https://www.wdm.iowa.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/38719/638146570113770000 and https://www.wdm.iowa.gov/Home/Components/News/News/4420 [inventory string truncated mid-URL; both flagged URLs identified from data.json])
fixed: Replaced https://www.wdm.iowa.gov/Home/Components/News/News/4420/384?arch=1&npage=12 (city news page, HTTP 403 to automated review) with verified Wayback snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20260712224557/https://www.wdm.iowa.gov/Home/Components/News/News/4420/ in actions[2].primary_url and sources.current_refresh_urls; snapshot (captured 2026-07-12) confirmed to contain the claimed content: 'four phases on 200 acres' and 'Total building construction is estimated at 1.7 million square feet'.
Added data.json history entry (2026-08-11, field 'sources') documenting the URL swap and the minutes-PDF dead_url_kept decision.

Added NOTES.md 2026-08-11 fix-pass note: wdm.iowa.gov domain returns HTTP 403 domain-wide to automated review (HEAD+GET and web fetcher all 403, root also 403); News/4420 swapped to Wayback snapshot with the original URL retained in the note; minutes PDF (showpublisheddocument/38719) kept with no Wayback copy (CDX empty) as dead_url_kept.
remaining_risks: Minutes PDF URL (showpublisheddocument/38719, actions[0].primary_url and sources.current_refresh_urls[0]) still returns HTTP 403 to automated review because the entire wdm.iowa.gov domain is WAF/IP-blocked from this environment (content presumed live; domain indexed by search engines); retained as dead_url_kept per brief for parent decision. No Wayback copy exists as of 2026-08-11 (CDX query empty).
The inventory.json issue string is itself truncated mid-URL ('.../News/4420'); the fix covers both flagged wdm.iowa.gov URLs as identified from the entry's sources/actions.
Replacement relies on archive.org availability; snapshot content was verified 2026-08-11 via both curl and the web fetcher.
summary: Fixed the source-reachability issue for the two flagged wdm.iowa.gov URLs (both HTTP 403 to automated review; domain-wide WAF/IP block confirmed). Replaced the News/4420 city news page with a verified Wayback snapshot (content matching 'four phases / 200 acres / ~1.7M sq ft' confirmed) in actions[2].primary_url and sources.current_refresh_urls, documented the swap in history and NOTES.md. The minutes PDF (showpublisheddocument/38719) has no Wayback copy and was kept as dead_url_kept pending parent decision; data.json validated as valid JSON.
